info.name: Welvie - Tenants API
info.description: 44 test cases cho Tenant APIs từ basic design/document.json: CRUD, lock/unlock, export, status/options, CS handover, tenant administrators, billing notice và service types. Import cùng welvie-stg.postman_environment.json và chạy đúng thứ tự. Handover positive mặc định skip để tránh chuyển dữ liệu hàng loạt; chỉ chạy khi chủ động cấu hình hai biến environment.

exec: if (tenantCases.has(tc) && !pm.collectionVariables.get('tenant_id')) { console.log(`SKIP ${tc}: TC_005 chưa tạo tenant_id`); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
if (['TC_028','TC_029','TC_030','TC_031'].includes(tc) && !pm.collectionVariables.get('tenant_admin_id')) { console.log(`SKIP ${tc}: TC_026 chưa lấy tenant_admin_id`); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }

if (tc==='TC_005' && (!pm.collectionVariables.get('tn_cs_id') || !pm.collectionVariables.get('tn_service_type_id'))) { console.log('SKIP TC_005: thiếu CS hoặc Service Type setup data'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }

if (tc==='TC_023' && (!pm.environment.get('handover_from_cs_id') || !pm.environment.get('handover_to_cs_id'))) { console.log('SKIP TC_023: handover cần opt-in bằng 2 environment variables'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
const n=pm.info.requestName; const tc=(n.match(/TC_\d{3}/)||[null])[0]; const setup=n.startsWith('SETUP'); const cleanup=n.startsWith('CLEANUP');

pm.test('Content-Type JSON',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')||'').to.include('application/json')); let j; pm.test('Response JSON object',()=>{j=pm.response.json();pm.expect(j).to.be.an('object')}); if(!j)throw new Error('Response không phải JSON');

if(setup&&pm.response.code===200){if(n.includes('Login')){pm.collectionVariables.set('tn_access_token',j.data.access_token);const x=`${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2,8)}`;pm.collectionVariables.set('tn_name',`auto_api_tenant_${x}`);pm.collectionVariables.set('tn_updated_name',`auto_api_tenant_updated_${x}`);pm.collectionVariables.set('tn_initial_admin_email',`auto_api_tenant_admin_${x}@example.com`);pm.collectionVariables.set('tn_second_admin_email',`auto_api_tenant_admin2_${x}@example.com`);pm.collectionVariables.set('tn_branch_name',`auto_api_branch_${x}`);pm.collectionVariables.unset('tenant_id');pm.collectionVariables.unset('tenant_admin_id');}if(n.includes('Customer Support')){pm.test('Có ít nhất một CS option',()=>pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty);if(j.data?.[0])pm.collectionVariables.set('tn_cs_id',String(j.data[0].id));}if(n.includes('Service Type')){pm.test('Có ít nhất một Service Type',()=>pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty);if(j.data?.[0])pm.collectionVariables.set('tn_service_type_id',String(j.data[0].id));}}

if(['TC_009','TC_014','TC_026'].includes(tc)&&pm.response.code===200){pm.test('Tenant detail đúng ID',()=>pm.expect(String(j.data.id)).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('tenant_id')));if(tc==='TC_009')pm.test('Show đúng name create',()=>pm.expect(j.data.name).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('tn_name')));if(tc==='TC_014')pm.test('Update đã persist',()=>{pm.expect(j.data.name).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('tn_updated_name'));pm.expect(j.data.staff_limit).to.equal(20)});if(tc==='TC_026'){const a=(j.data.administrators||[]).find(x=>x.email===pm.collectionVariables.get('tn_second_admin_email'));pm.test('Tìm thấy admin thứ hai',()=>pm.expect(a).to.be.an('object'));if(a)pm.collectionVariables.set('tenant_admin_id',String(a.id));}}
